Sara Farnya <support@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi Chloé,After thoroughly investigating this issue, we have identified the root cause. Previously, the Time Triggering Logic for Questionnaire #36 was based on the Registration Date instead of the Registration Time. Because the First Trigger is set to occur After 0 days at 00:00:00, the questionnaire would only be prompted if participants joined the study exactly at midnight. It appears you have recently corrected this by changing it to be based on the Registration Time. As a result, it should work properly for new participants moving forward.Could you please check with a new participant to confirm that they will receive Questionnaire #36 if they identify themselves as the mother of the child in Questionnaire #1 (Q1_5 == 1)?If this is confirmed, we can manually prompt Questionnaire #36 for all participants who have identified themselves as mothers so far.
